item.title: Formosan Presbyterian Church in Los Angeles (FPCLA)
item.description: Formosan Presbyterian Church in Los Angeles (FPCLA) Formosan Presbyterian Church in Los Angeles (FPCLA) was the first Taiwanese Presbyterian church established in North America, founded in 1970 in Los Angeles, California.
